subject: How do I generate line graphs from selected rows of a data table

messages.author: 70d816b544c9b486
messages.subject: How do I generate line graphs from selected rows of a data table
parts:
Hello,

 

Would really appreciate your help on this.  Each time a user clicks on a row of a data table,  generate a line graph using data of that row.  Label the generated line graph using the text  in the first column of the clicked row.  If the user clicks on another row, then add another line graph using a different color.  When the user clicks on a row, that already has its line graph generated, then remove that line graph.

 

Below is the code that creates my data table:

 

    inputtable <- reactive({
      iFile <- tmpFileGroupFlux
     
      if (is.null(iFile))
        return(NULL)
      read.table(tmpFileGroupFlux, header=TRUE, sep="|", quote = "", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
    })
    output$table = DT::renderDataTable(inputtable())

 

 

Thank you very much.
